welcomeMessage: Hi! I'm the FandomVerse Guide. What would you like to explore?

predefinedQuestions.question: What is FandomVerse?
predefinedQuestions.answer: FandomVerse is a centralized entertainment and fandom discovery portal where you can explore Anime, Gaming, Movies, TV Shows, K-Pop, Comics, and Manga from one unified platform. We bring together news, trailers, character dossiers, merchandise, and live event schedules.

predefinedQuestions.question: What can I explore here?
predefinedQuestions.answer: You can explore 7 distinct fandom hubs, read 60+ in-depth articles, inspect 35+ detailed character profiles, watch the latest trailers, listen to podcasts, browse interactive image galleries in a full-screen lightbox, discover upcoming conventions, and build a merchandise wishlist.

predefinedQuestions.question: Show me Anime content
predefinedQuestions.answer: FandomVerse Anime includes articles on Studio MAPPA and Ufotable, character dossiers (Luffy, Gojo, Tanjiro, Frieren), interactive photo galleries, latest trailers, convention listings, merchandise, and seasonal release radars.

predefinedQuestions.question: Show me Gaming content
predefinedQuestions.answer: Our Gaming Hub covers AAA blockbusters like GTA VI, Elden Ring, and God of War, character archives (Geralt, Master Chief, Kratos), esports tournaments like EVO, playable podcasts, and upcoming game release calendars.

predefinedQuestions.question: Where can I find Movies?
predefinedQuestions.answer: Head over to the Movies Hub to explore cinematic blockbusters like Dune: Part Two, The Batman, and IMAX epics. You'll find behind-the-scenes features, trailer breakdowns, film festival schedules, and character deep-dives.

predefinedQuestions.question: How do I find characters?
predefinedQuestions.answer: Every category hub has a dedicated 'Popular Characters' section featuring at least 5 character profiles with biographies, traits, and series affiliations. You can also click on any character card to open their full interactive profile modal.

predefinedQuestions.question: Where are the latest trailers?
predefinedQuestions.answer: We have a dedicated 'Trailers & Media' hub accessible from the navigation or directly on each category page. It brings together video trailers, studio interviews, fan showcases, and playable podcast audio clips.

predefinedQuestions.question: How do I use the merchandise cart?
predefinedQuestions.answer: Browse official fan gear (figures, apparel, vinyl, art prints), click 'Add to Cart', and open your cart drawer from the header. You can adjust quantities and see real-time price calculations. Note: This is a client-side demo cart; no checkout or real payment is processed.

predefinedQuestions.question: How do bookmarks work?
predefinedQuestions.answer: Click the bookmark icon on any article, character, or event card to save it to your browser's Local Storage. Visit the dedicated Bookmarks page to review them, write personal notes saved for your current session in Session Storage, and export your bookmarks as a formatted list!

predefinedQuestions.question: What fandom categories are available?
predefinedQuestions.answer: FandomVerse features 7 comprehensive categories: 1. Anime, 2. Gaming, 3. Movies, 4. TV Shows, 5. K-Pop, 6. Comics, and 7. Manga. Each hub is fully populated with articles, media, and characters.

predefinedQuestions.question: What are upcoming events?
predefinedQuestions.answer: Check our Events page to see major upcoming pop-culture gatherings like San Diego Comic-Con, Anime Expo, Gamescom, Tokyo Dome MAMA Awards, and New York Comic Con, complete with dates, venues, and status.

predefinedQuestions.question: How does search work?
predefinedQuestions.answer: Our global search bar is located in the top navigation (press Ctrl+K anywhere to jump to it). It searches across articles, characters, trailers, events, and merchandise in real-time, with filters for category, content type, and sorting options.
